newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius' MEI profit improved by 17 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius' MEI profit improved by 17 percent.

text.p: Mauritian Eagle Insurance (MEI) on Friday reported a 17 percent rise on profit before tax to 23.6 million rupees ($1.2 million) for the year ended 31 December 1996 from 20.2 million rupees the previous year.

MEI's turnover for the year ended 31 December 1996 rose to 150.9 million rupees, against 131.0 million rupees for the year ended 31 December 1995, an overall growth of 15 percent, company officials said.
The profit after tax for the year ended 31 December 1996 was posted at 18.5 million rupees from 16.2 million rupees during the same period in 1995.
